summary: In-Person Session Booking feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest passing — POST /inperson/booking/request happy path (client) + 403 non-client + 400 invalid date/time; GET /inperson/bookings client-scoped + admin-all + ?client_id filter; approve/decline/cancel with proper RBAC; approve persists status + sets user.inperson_next_session; /register-push route wired (returns 500 with placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY as designed — EXPECTED, not a bug); regression endpoints (/inperson/clients, /thread/{id}, /message) OK. Frontend: bot2 (client) sees 'REQUEST A TRAINING SESSION' on ME tab, BookingModal opens with calendar + half-hourly slots (slot-07:30 etc), submit creates a booking that shows PENDING. Admin /inperson lists clients, opening Iron Sentinel shows SESSIONS section with PENDING approve/decline buttons, APPROVE flips row to CONFIRMED. bot3 (non-client) sees enrollment button 'request-inperson' and NOT the session-request button.

integration_issues.issue: On direct navigation to /inperson as a client, the room showed the loading spinner for >6s and ip-request-session / ip-sessions-calendar were not visible during the test window. Admin view of the same thread renders SESSIONS + calendar correctly, and the testIDs exist in inperson.tsx (lines 425/436). Likely just slow first-load / needs longer wait — worth confirming manually.

action_items: Optional: confirm the CLIENT view of /inperson eventually paints ip-request-session + ip-sessions-calendar (took >6s in preview). If it never appears for a bot2-style client, check the useEffect fetch path in inperson.tsx and any guard that hides the SESSIONS section for clients.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking endpoints correctly validate date/time regex and enforce inperson_client requirement (routes/inperson.py:604-618).
Approve/decline are admin-only via _require_admin_ip; cancel allows owner client OR admin (routes/inperson.py:686-694) — correct.
Approve sets users.inperson_next_session to '{date} at {time}' (routes/inperson.py:657) — visible on the client card.
Booking IDs use new_id('ipbk') and are excluded from _id serialization via {'_id':0} projection — safe.
_compute_appt_at uses tz_offset_minutes from client's JS getTimezoneOffset() and stores appt_at in UTC — correct for the reminder loop.
/register-push in routes/push.py:14 returns 500 (missing key) / 502 (provider down) in preview — expected because EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is a placeholder; route is wired properly.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all required flows verified except client /inperson calendar load timing)

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ bookings via API against bot2 during testing (approved / declined / cancelled). No manual DB seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testIDs are input-email / input-password / submit-auth. Profile tab is labeled 'ME'. Booking flow: click profile-request-session on ME tab → pick day in booking-calendar → tap slot-HH:MM → tap booking-submit. Admin /inperson list uses testID ip-client-{user_id}; opening a client thread renders ip-approve-{booking_id} / ip-decline-{booking_id}. Bots require dismissing mode intro (pick-full) on first login. localStorage must be cleared between account switches (used page.evaluate(localStorage.clear())).
